questions.text: We must behave well in the classroom. Which of the following is NOT a good etiquette in the school?

options.label: Teacher teaching attentive students in class
Students jumping on desks and benches
Students running and pushing on the stairs

questions.text: Which safety measure one can follow in the home?

options.text: Do not lean over a balcony railing
Cross the road at zebra crossing

questions.text: We should ______ waste food and water.
Sangeeta got less marks in the test. She should

options.text: Study hard to get good marks in the next test

questions.text: Which of the following is a healthy/good habit?

options.text: Radhika takes lift, instead of the stairs, to reach her apartment on first floor.
Neha everyday reads one short story from her story book.
Geeta always includes fast food in her diet.

questions.text: Your mother is busy with her household chores and you hear your home's doorbell. What will you do in this situation?

options.text: You should tell your mother to open the door.
You should shout at your mother to open the door.
You should go to your room and start watching television.

questions.text: Which of the following is the first thing that you should do after returning from school?
If your class teacher makes you monitor of the class, what will you do/feel?

options.text: You will boast about this to your friends.
You will ask your teacher that you do not want to be a monitor as it is a tedious job.
You will ask your classmates to bring different dishes for you daily since you are a monitor.
You will feel more responsible and try to do your duty with honesty.
